name: schedule

scripts.conformance: npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract schedule.list --args '{}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract schedule.create --args '{"text":"conformance 测试","inMinutes":600}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract schedule.cancel --args '{"id":"nonexistent"}'

description: CAK 插件：给 agent 定闹钟/定时任务，到点把一句话投递给 agent 会话把它叫醒（schedule.create / list / cancel）
